_about: Canonical DESIRED branch protection for the 'main' branch of Imagine-That-Ai/BurnBar. This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH — see governance/README.md. It encodes the solo-maintainer automation contract: required status checks and required conversation resolution are hard gates; PR-review, CODEOWNER-review, last-push-approval, force-push, and deletion bypasses must not block or weaken the lane. As of Operation 9 P-QA-3, required_status_checks.strict is true to prevent stale-base greens (QA finding M-1); strict is the conservative option over a merge queue because it does not require every required context to also fire on the merge_group event.
_derivation: required_status_checks.contexts were read from the live main branch protection on 2026-07-08. Only check-run names currently required by GitHub are listed; keep this file and live protection in sync. strict was set to true in P-QA-3 (Operation 9) to prevent stale-base greens; the owner intentionally changed the contract per governance/README.md.

_pending_required_status_checks._comment: PLACEHOLDER — future-required checks. Do NOT copy these into required_status_checks.contexts (above) or into the live ruleset until the emitting workflow exists and has reported the context on 'pull_request' at least once. A required context that is never reported leaves every PR pending forever. Promote each entry into required_status_checks.contexts in the SAME change that lands its workflow — or, once the workflow is already merged and observed reporting, in a follow-up operator change to the live ruleset. STATUS 2026-07-08: 'diff-coverage (PR)' is now EMITTED on every PR by the 'diff-coverage-ts' job in .github/workflows/fast-feedback.yml (real v8/istanbul changed-line intersection via scripts/diff-coverage-ts.sh; ≥80%; NO presence-based carve-out — the anti-pattern that gamed the prior gate, DILIGENCE_REPORT_2026-06-11.md §5.1 CG-1). It is kept here (NOT yet in required_status_checks.contexts) on purpose: making it REQUIRED is an operator-only branch-protection/ruleset change.
